parsed.internal_thinking: Bob is offering 1 Wood for 1 Brick. My current resources are 2 Wood, 1 Brick, and 2 Sheep. My immediate goal is to build a settlement at Node 9 (the 3:1 port), which requires 1 Wood, 1 Brick, 1 Wheat, and 1 Sheep. Brick is my rarest resource right now, and I already have enough Wood (2) to build the settlement once I get the Wheat. Trading away my only Brick for a resource I already have plenty of makes no strategic sense, especially since Bob is my primary rival and previously betrayed me. I'll reject the trade.
parsed.note_to_self: Rejected Bob's Wood-for-Brick trade. Hand remains 2W, 1B, 2S. Still need Wheat for Node 9. Bob has Wood and Sheep.
parsed.say_outloud: Nice try, Bob, but I'm not letting go of my only brick for wood I already have. You'll have to find someone else to bail you out.
